انتهزن (form VIII)
# اِنْتَهَزْنَ (intahazna) /in.ta.haz.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِنْتَهَزَ (intahaza)
# اُنْتُهِزْنَ (untuhizna) /un.tu.hiz.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِنْتَهَزَ (intahaza)
# اِنْتَهِزْنَ (intahizna) /in.ta.hiz.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِنْتَهَزَ (intahaza)
